title: On Quantifying and Understanding the Role of Ethics in AI Research: A Historical Account of Flagship Conferences and Journals
benchmark_measurement: The paper's benchmark measured the historical frequency of a predefined list of ethics-related keywords (e.g., 'ethics', 'privacy', 'racism', 'accountability') in the titles and abstracts of papers from major AI conferences and journals. It did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper found a relatively low and inconsistent level of attention paid to ethical topics within the mainstream AI research community over several decades. No findings related to religion were presented as it was not a focus of the analysis; religion was mentioned only once as an example of a sensitive personal attribute.
